headline: Jurors Demand Clarification on Stalking Charge as Durk Trial Intensifies
body: DJ Akademiks reports jurors sent two notes this morning seeking clarification on specific phrases and words related to the stalking conspiracy charge and intent to murder in Lil Durk's trial. The juror requests come amid ongoing legal tensions, with the judge refusing to provide further explanations. This development has sparked debate over the trial's progress and potential implications for the case's outcome.

caption:
Jurors in Lil Durk's trial have sent two notes asking for clarification on specific terms related to the stalking conspiracy charge and intent to murder. The judge has refused to provide further explanations, raising concerns about the trial's direction. Meanwhile, Trap Lore Ross notes the jury wants more answers but the judge cannot give them.
